wiki.title: Frank Lucas (Oklahoma politician)
wiki.extract: Frank Dean Lucas is an American politician and farmer serving as the U.S. representative for Oklahoma's 3rd congressional district since 2003. A member of the Republican Party, he previously represented the 6th district from 1994 to 2003, prior to redistricting.
